full_launch_abi.scope: Complete normal launch with original distance/heading/sound runtime boundaries. Every call register and independent actor/math-scratch/sound-global state compares before and after callbacks. Callback mutations drive live position, sound index, volume/table rereads; full-width geometry returns verify word truncation and heading modulo. Exact original EAX actor handle compares. Faulting runtime geometry and register-clobbering callbacks remain outside normal boundary.

full_fly_out_abi.scope: Complete normal fly handlers execute real timer, rotation/orbit and signed transition helpers, with only 0x4b14c0 supplied. Exact measurement registers, full-width output dimensions, independent 0x160 actor/flag state before and after callbacks, late actor mutation reads and exact original EAX compare. Dword/radius transition returns and handler arrival compare. Arithmetic faults, callback register clobbers and exceptional execution remain outside the normal boundary.
